title: NEBExpress Ni Resin Pressurized Column Protocol
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfa4jigw

steps.title: Prepare Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare Lysis/Binding, Wash, and Elution Buffers. If using denaturing conditions, bring all three buffers to a final concentration of 8M Urea or 6M Guanidine.

substeps.instruction: Ensure Lysis buffer does not contain imidazole.
Optionally increase imidazole in wash buffer to 15 mM to minimize contaminants (determine concentration empirically).

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells by centrifugation at 4000 x g, 4°C, for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Pre-weigh the vessel prior to addition of cell suspension to determine the mass of the cell pellet.
Store the pellet at -20°C or process immediately.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in Lysis buffer and lyse using a method of choice (e.g., sonication, repeated freeze-thaw cycles, French press, or commercial reagents).

substeps.instruction: Use approximately 5 mL of lysis buffer per gram of cell paste.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 12000 x g, 4°C, for 15 minutes to pellet cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the clarified protein lysate supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube on ice.
Retain an aliquot of the clarified lysate for SDS-PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Pack and Run Column
steps.instruction: Pack the NEBExpress Ni Resin column and run the purification using a pressurized FPLC system.

substeps.instruction: Pack columns at a constant pressure of approximately 1 bar (0.1 MPa) or a packing flow velocity of approximately 400 cm/h (10cm bed height, 25°C, low viscosity buffer).
Ensure the maximum pressure for the resin does not exceed 3 bar (0.3 MPa).

steps.title: Clean Column (Optional)
steps.instruction: If using a gravity column, determine the flow rate prior to cleaning. Use one of the following methods to remove specific contaminants:

substeps.instruction: To remove lipoproteins, lipids, and hydrophobic proteins: Add 1 M NaOH (contact time 1-2 hours), followed by 10 CV of Lysis/Binding Buffer; OR add 30% isopropanol (contact time 15-20 minutes), followed by 10 CV of water; OR add 0.1–0.5% non-ionic detergent in 0.1 M acetic acid (contact time 1-2 hours), followed by 10 CV of water.
To remove proteins bound by ionic interactions: Add 1.5 M NaCl (contact time 10-15 minutes), followed by 10 CV of water.

steps.title: Store Resin
steps.instruction: Store NEBExpress Ni Resin in 20% ethanol at 2–8°C for long-term storage.
